public.task: Investigate every request in this run that tried to read tenant records (route GET /tenants/{tenant}/records). For each such request, identified by its request_id, determine: (1) whether the service allowed or denied it; (2) whether an INDEPENDENT observer (not the application's own instrumentation) recorded the resulting data read on the tenant database in the evidence available to you; (3) whether the request tried to read a tenant other than the requesting principal's own tenant, regardless of whether it succeeded. Use unknown wherever the evidence cannot establish an answer.
